name: Ionic Liquid-Polymer Hybrid Electrolyte
mechanism: Polymer matrix encapsulates ionic liquid to suppress solvent evaporation via covalent bonding.
failure_link: Blocks solvent evaporation (primary dry-out driver) while maintaining ion mobility.
source: credit-register lead (1.0.0; pair WINNER, restored per Amendment 2 P0-1)
repair_directives: State the ESR budget against the acetonitrile baseline (Amendment 1 salvage)
Resolve the immobilization-vs-mobility tension: the polymer matrix must immobilize the ionic liquid against evaporation while the ions stay mobile enough to hold capacitance (Amendment 1 salvage)
The mechanism must NOT claim osmosis drives vapor transport — osmosis is liquid-phase transport across a semipermeable membrane (the R2 category error)
